includes: Diving: 4 daytime dives and 1 night dive daily, enriched air included for YSS divers, day trip to Verde Island
Food and drinks: full breakfast, 3-course lunch and dinner, snacks, coffee, tea, filtered water
Transfers: from Manila to Puerto Galera, marine park fee, unlimited Wi-Fi
Maldives trip: 7-night liveaboard, up to 4 dives per day, all meals and non-alcoholic beverages onboard
Fiji trip: 7 nights accommodation, 5 days of 2-tank boat dives on Nitrox, 2 night dives, free shore dives, roundtrip airport transfers
gap: Age minimums and certification requirements not stated
blurb: YSS Dive provides scuba diving adventures including liveaboard trips to the Maldives, Philippines, Fiji, and the Sea of Cortez. They offer equipment rentals and guided dive charters with diverse marine life encounters. Trips include accommodations, meals, and multiple daily dives with options for night dives and enriched air.
extraNote: Non-refundable deposit $500 due at booking for Philippines trip · Flexible payment plans available for Maldives trip · Tips customary 10–15% for Sea of Cortez trip · Airfare, gratuities, and some fees not included in trip prices · Dive shops in Shelton and Port Townsend, WA
